rules.name: Classic SQL Injection - Union Based
rules.description: Detects UNION SELECT queries attempting to extract database tables and schema.

rules.name: SQL Injection - Boolean & Tautology Bypass
rules.description: Detects tautological statements (' OR '1'='1), SQL comments (-- or #), and stacked queries.

rules.name: SQL Injection - Time-based & Blind Probe
rules.description: Detects blind sleep-based SQL injection and file write/read directives.

rules.name: Automated SQL Scanner User-Agent
rules.description: Detects known automated automated vulnerability scanner user-agents.

rules.name: XSS - Explicit Script Tags
rules.description: Detects inline or external <script> execution tags in payload.

rules.name: XSS - Dangerous HTML Event Handlers
rules.description: Detects HTML attributes with inline JS event handlers like onerror= or onload=.

rules.name: XSS - Pseudo-protocols & JavaScript Execution
rules.description: Detects javascript: pseudo-protocols, document.cookie theft, and DOM execution.

rules.name: Path Traversal / Directory Stepping
rules.description: Detects parent directory traversal stepping patterns in paths and query params.

rules.name: Local File Inclusion - Sensitive System Targets
rules.description: Detects attempts to access UNIX / Windows system credential files or PHP wrappers.

rules.name: Remote Code Execution - Shell Command Chaining
rules.description: Detects chained command execution targeting OS system binaries.

rules.name: Remote Code Execution - PHP System Execution Calls
rules.description: Detects PHP system execution functions invoked via web input parameters.

rules.name: Cross-Site Request Forgery - Anomalous Origin Check
rules.description: Detects forged state-changing requests or test tokens bypassing anti-CSRF.

rules.name: Web Shell Signatures & Obfuscated Payloads
rules.description: Detects known PHP web shells, backdoors, and base64 eval execution chains.
